css: .b2b-invoice{font-family:Inter,Arial,sans-serif;color:#172033;font-size:11px}.inv-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:24px;border-bottom:2px solid #172033;padding-bottom:14px;margin-bottom:18px}.inv-brand h1{margin:0 0 4px;font-size:24px}.muted{color:#667085}.item-code{font-size:9px;color:#667085;margin-top:2px}.inv-title{text-align:right}.inv-title h2{margin:0 0 5px;font-size:19px}.inv-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:16px;margin-bottom:18px}.box{border:1px solid #d7dee8;border-radius:7px;padding:11px}.box h3{font-size:10px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em;color:#667085;margin:0 0 7px}.kv{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;padding:2px 0}.items{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;margin:14px 0}.items th{background:#f2f4f7;text-align:left;padding:7px;border-bottom:1px solid #cfd7e3}.items td{padding:7px;border-bottom:1px solid #eaecf0;vertical-align:top}.num{text-align:right!important}.summary{width:44%;margin-left:auto}.summary .row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;padding:4px 0}.summary .total{font-size:15px;font-weight:800;border-top:2px solid #172033;margin-top:5px;padding-top:8px}.fbr{margin-top:16px;padding:10px;border:1px solid #cfe8e5;background:#f1faf8;border-radius:7px}.fbr-content{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;margin-top:8px}.fbr-qr{width:25.4mm;height:25.4mm;display:block;flex:0 0 auto}.fbr-details{flex:1}.fbr-note{font-size:9px;color:#667085;margin-top:6px}.footer{margin-top:24px;border-top:1px solid #d7dee8;padding-top:10px;color:#667085;font-size:9px}@media print{@page{size:A4;margin:12mm}}
